title: SyncStatusIndicator hardcodes English UI strings and is never referenced by any production screen

evidence.quote: // All user-facing strings in SyncStatusIndicator are hardcoded English inside

why: Every label ('Local only', 'Synced', 'Syncing', '$n pending', '$n queued', 'Offline', 'Sync error', 'Sync paused'...) is a raw English literal rendered via Tooltip/Text, not routed through AppLocalizations -- a direct AX-2 violation in an EN+Hebrew app. The widget's own test file documents this exact list in a 'Hardcoded string audit' comment as 'a flag for future i18n work.' Grepping lib/, SyncStatusIndicator is referenced by nothing in production -- only by its own test -- so today the violation has zero user reach, but it is a landmine: whoever wires this widget into a real screen (a natural fit for settings/dashboard, its whole purpose) ships untranslated text with no warning beyond a comment nobody reads at the call site.
recommendation: Either delete SyncStatusIndicator (its job is already covered by backup_sync_section.dart's localized cloud-status card) or localize it via AppLocalizations before it is ever wired up; do not leave it in this half-finished state.
acceptance_criteria: AX-2 literal-string checker (once the [P] literal-detection lint lands) reports zero hits in this file, or the file no longer exists.
